title: Choose the voice LLM in the agent form without editing JSON
outcome: An operator can deliberately create, edit, publish and activate a Google/Gemini voice configuration through visible form controls, while existing published configurations remain unchanged.
acceptance: Creation and editing expose labelled LLM provider/model controls. New-agent form starts with the owner-selected browser-pilot preset Google / gemini-3.5-flash-lite; this is a UI preset, not a change to backend defaults or an approval of a production provider.

Submitting the creation form sends the selected valid voice.llm_provider/llm_model pair in config. Show the selected pair before submission; never silently substitute OpenAI. Do not claim a model is authenticated, free or available merely because it is selectable.

Loading an existing OpenAI configuration preserves it until explicitly edited. Legacy Gemini 2.5 snapshots remain readable and unchanged; do not rewrite published rows or active bindings when opening the editor.

Changing the provider offers only models allowed by the current server contract and uses a valid explicit pair. Invalid or malformed advanced JSON produces a visible error and does not send a destructive save. Form and advanced JSON have one coherent state, without losing instructions, locale, tools, references or unrelated configuration fields.

Show the saved draft model separately from the locally active version model, or clearly indicate that active model details are unavailable. Saving draft never implies publication/activation. Existing optimistic concurrency errors remain visible without discarding unsaved changes.

Viewer cannot create or change configurations; operator/admin behavior continues to use the existing authorized endpoints and CSRF protection. No credentials or environment values are introduced in frontend code, fixtures or logs.

Add a synthetic browser regression covering Google creation, changing an existing OpenAI draft to Google, publication/activation with correct active version, preservation of unrelated JSON fields, and viewer read-only behavior. Tests do not contact LiveKit, Gemini, STT or TTS.

Update configuration documentation and provide exact owner acceptance steps. No deployment, live calls, dependency updates, backend/provider changes, automatic publication or automatic model fallback are included.
